source_summary.scope: CPU coefficient recomputation on frozen TRAINING rollouts; no gradients, policy updates or performance prediction.

scale.weighting: Valid coefficients only; w=response_len / all output tokens in that session. Invalid min(A,-0.5) applied afterward.

decomposition.caution: Equal first-attempt weights within each four-path original-turn group; not claimed to be token-weighted orthogonal decomposition.

validation.note: No production files, jobs, queues, checkpoints or model weights changed.

scope: existing cumulative TRAINING rollouts only; no test questions; fixed before new training
